--- title: "Appendices 1–5: Entity Load Assessments" --- Appendices 1–5 present the per-entity, per-facility allocation assessment for each bay segment over the 2022–2025 Reasonable Assurance period. For each entity the table lists the facility (point-source discharge or MS4), its allocation (percent of remaining load, where applicable, and TMDL-equivalent tons/yr), and the mean annual **effective load** over 2022–2025, with an allocation status. Each table is rendered natively from a per-segment CSV in `data/`. ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} **Source.** These are the "Assessment" tables generated by the TBEP [`load-reporting`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-reporting) pipeline (`show_aaassess()`, from `data/aa2225.RData`) — the same tables published at — covering **2022–2025**. A facility whose effective load is at or below its allocated tons is *within allocation*; one above is flagged *exceeds allocation*. Per entity, the **Total** row compares the entity's combined effective load to its combined allocation. ::: ## Appendix 1. ``` ::: ::: ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} An "exceeds allocation" status for an individual facility does **not** by itself indicate a segment-level reasonable-assurance failure. Under the NMC framework (Tables 2–6, Section 2.d), entity/facility exceedances are evaluated (NMC Actions 4–5) only when a segment's chlorophyll-*a* threshold is not met, and entity-generated reductions are retained as indefinite credits (2009 RA Addendum §IX.D). All segments met their chlorophyll-*a* thresholds over 2022–2026. ::: ::: {.provenance} **Appendices 1–5:** TBEP [`load-reporting`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-reporting) "Assessment" outputs (`drafttables.qmd` → `show_aaassess()`, `data/aa2225.RData`), 2022–2025. Allocation percentages and TMDL-equivalent loads correspond to **Tables 10–14** (*Action Plan & Allocation Tables* chapter). :::
